dataset.name: hiv_moleculenet_replay_v1
dataset.label_semantics: Historical NCI DTP screen: CA and CM mapped to active=1; CI to inactive=0; not clinical efficacy.
dataset.source: Original in-process synthetic generator; no external data.
dataset.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only to revealed training rows.

manifest.scheduler: At most batch_size concurrent pending assays; settle each result at its due step.
manifest.cost_note: Reserve on request; settle on delivery or missing outcome; no refunds.
manifest.delay_note: Integer simulated steps; deterministic nonnegative per-candidate jitter.

dataset_provenance.attribution: NCI DTP AIDS Antiviral Screen; Wu et al., MoleculeNet (2018), DOI 10.1039/C7SC02664A; DeepChem; Therapeutics Data Commons.
dataset_provenance.benchmark_scope: Custom historical replay subset, not official MoleculeNet/TDC leaderboard split or reproduction.
dataset_provenance.changes: Removed invalid/duplicate canonical structures; label-blind 1200-row subset; canonical SMILES, Morgan bits and Murcko scaffolds added.
dataset_provenance.cost_delay_provenance: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION, independent of historical assay outcomes
dataset_provenance.label_semantics: CA/CM=1; CI=0, checked against HIV_active for every source record
dataset_provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated for HIV by Therapeutics Data Commons
dataset_provenance.name: MoleculeNet HIV label-blind replay subset
dataset_provenance.preprocessing: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES; no salt stripping, tautomer normalization or stereo removal; Morgan radius=2, bits=1024; Murcko nonchiral scaffolds.

limitations: Personal independent prototype; not an official GPO project or endorsed system.
Data origin and assay semantics are dataset-specific; retrospective labels are not drug efficacy evidence.
Cost, capacity, delay and missingness are SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION; no currency or actual savings.
Seed labels are common preexisting sunk cost and excluded from new hits. Only synthetic seeds are stratified.
Logistic probabilities are uncalibrated; closeness to 0.5 is a heuristic, not validated uncertainty.
Single-seed comparisons illustrate behavior. Multi-seed variability on one assay is not cross-target validation.
Learned controllers train on synthetic tasks only; no validated pharmaceutical transfer, lab integration, Digital Twin or GMP/clinical use.
Built-in policy process separation is not an OS sandbox for hostile code or reconstructed synthetic truth.

dataset.name: hiv_moleculenet_replay_v1
dataset.label_semantics: Historical NCI DTP screen: CA and CM mapped to active=1; CI to inactive=0; not clinical efficacy.
dataset.source: Original in-process synthetic generator; no external data.
dataset.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only to revealed training rows.

controller.reward: new delivered active hits - 0.01 * newly settled cost units
controller.state_definition: remaining budget tertile, observed positive-rate bin, known-count bin, two-class flag, pending flag

manifest.scheduler: At most batch_size concurrent pending assays; settle each result at its due step.
manifest.cost_note: Reserve on request; settle on delivery or missing outcome; no refunds.
manifest.delay_note: Integer simulated steps; deterministic nonnegative per-candidate jitter.

dataset_provenance.attribution: NCI DTP AIDS Antiviral Screen; Wu et al., MoleculeNet (2018), DOI 10.1039/C7SC02664A; DeepChem; Therapeutics Data Commons.
dataset_provenance.benchmark_scope: Custom historical replay subset, not official MoleculeNet/TDC leaderboard split or reproduction.
dataset_provenance.changes: Removed invalid/duplicate canonical structures; label-blind 1200-row subset; canonical SMILES, Morgan bits and Murcko scaffolds added.
dataset_provenance.cost_delay_provenance: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION, independent of historical assay outcomes
dataset_provenance.label_semantics: CA/CM=1; CI=0, checked against HIV_active for every source record
dataset_provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated for HIV by Therapeutics Data Commons
dataset_provenance.name: MoleculeNet HIV label-blind replay subset
dataset_provenance.preprocessing: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES; no salt stripping, tautomer normalization or stereo removal; Morgan radius=2, bits=1024; Murcko nonchiral scaffolds.

limitations: Personal independent prototype; not an official GPO project or endorsed system.
Data origin and assay semantics are dataset-specific; retrospective labels are not drug efficacy evidence.
Cost, capacity, delay and missingness are SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION; no currency or actual savings.
Seed labels are common preexisting sunk cost and excluded from new hits. Only synthetic seeds are stratified.
Logistic probabilities are uncalibrated; closeness to 0.5 is a heuristic, not validated uncertainty.
Single-seed comparisons illustrate behavior. Multi-seed variability on one assay is not cross-target validation.
Learned controllers train on synthetic tasks only; no validated pharmaceutical transfer, lab integration, Digital Twin or GMP/clinical use.
Built-in policy process separation is not an OS sandbox for hostile code or reconstructed synthetic truth.
